pages.title: Cancer as a notifiable disease — Rajya Sabha Committee on Petitions

facts.text: Committee: Committee on Petitions, Rajya Sabha — headed by Narain Dass Gupta
facts.head: News

facts.text: Report: 163rd report (20 August 2025) — declare cancer a notifiable disease in all States/UTs
facts.head: News

facts.text: Current data: National Cancer Registry Programme (NCRP) covers only 18% of population
facts.head: News

facts.text: Present norm (WHO): only communicable diseases notifiable
facts.head: News

facts.text: Oral cancer: ~60,000 new cases a year; over 5 deaths every hour; Indians affected younger (≤40 years)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Other recommendations: high-risk cess on tobacco earmarked for cancer care; compulsory service for govt-funded medical graduates; more oncology R&D; inter-ministerial plan on environmental carcinogens
facts.head: News

facts.text: Linked programme: NPCDCS; SDG 3
facts.head: News
